mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification(user_id, draw_no, ticket_id, prize_level, prize_amount, is_read, create_time, update_time) VALUES(#{userId}, #{drawNo}, #{ticketId}, #{prizeLevel}, #{prizeAmount}, 0, NOW(), NOW())

INSERT INTO notification(user_id, draw_no, ticket_id, prize_level, prize_amount, is_read, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{n.userId}, #{n.drawNo}, #{n.ticketId}, #{n.prizeLevel}, #{n.prizeAmount}, 0, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT n.*, t.numbers FROM notification n LEFT JOIN ticket t ON n.ticket_id = t.id WHERE n.user_id = #{userId} AND n.is_read = 0 ORDER BY n.create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET is_read = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
